# requires: wire
#
# The other side of the same list. A retryable status classed as a refusal
# throws away a download this project exists to keep: 408, 425 and 429 say try
# later, 409 and 423 are somebody else's lock, 5xx is the far end having a bad
# moment, and an unrecognised 4xx is "not now" because being wrong that way
# costs less. Every one of these must leave the record in the sweep.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:status-408
run A alpha
submit B size=64 digest=good src=http:status-409
run B alpha
submit C size=64 digest=good src=http:status-418
run C alpha
submit D size=64 digest=good src=http:status-423
run D alpha
submit E size=64 digest=good src=http:status-425
run E alpha
submit F size=64 digest=good src=http:status-429
run F alpha
submit G size=64 digest=good src=http:status-500
run G alpha
submit H size=64 digest=good src=http:status-503
run H alpha
orphans

# expect 2: transfer-failed state=pending [DL-E5]
# expect 4: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 6: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 8: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 10: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 12: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 14: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 16: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 17: ok A B C D E F G H [DL-E6]
